primary_map.reason_chosen: Already in every TF2 install, open sightlines fit Peashooter/Cactus, hay bales fit the garden/zombie aesthetic without custom textures.

tf_bot_difficulty.comment: Hard — enough challenge solo, not Expert cheese

tf_bot_auto_vacate.comment: Kick a bot if a (nonexistent) player joins — safety net

mp_autoteambalance.comment: Keep 4 BLU plants vs 4 RED zombies, no swapping

mp_timelimit.comment: Minutes per round — matches KOTH default

bot_class_forcing.mechanism: tf_bot_add + tf_bot_force_class, run from autoexec after map load
bot_class_forcing.note: Human player picks any BLU class (defaults to Sniper→Cactus if auto-join). mp_autoteambalance=0 keeps the split clean.

autoexec_sequence: // cfg/mods/pvz_gw2_kit.cfg — sourced from autoexec.cfg on map load
// bot class forcing runs via server plugin hook — see hooks.json#bot_class_hook

fallback_map.reason: If harvest_final isn't present (very old install), viaduct is the other guaranteed KOTH map.

open_cells.blocker: Needs playtest. Open item in brief: 'Exact tf_bot_* cvars for a decent 4v4 KOTH match'.
